slide_title: Transformer Decoder: Encoder-Decoder Attention and Masked Multi-Head Self-Attention Blocks
subtitle_or_header: No subtitle bar; the header function is carried by two red callout boxes: 'Multi-head Encoder-Decoder Attention Block' (upper) and 'Masked Multi-head Self Attention Block' (lower)

labels: Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]

layout.arrangement: No title bar; the whole slide is one large schematic framed by a thin dark-red rectangle. Top-left corner holds two red-bordered callout boxes with thick red arrows pointing into the diagram. The right two-thirds is two stacked rounded containers: an upper beige container (top row of five token-square groups each with a short downward arrow, dark-red Residual/Norm bar, green Feed-Forward bar, second dark-red Residual/Norm bar, five royal-blue 'Encode Decoder Attention' 3D boxes with one K and one V circle entering from the left and five Q circles entering from below) and a lower pink container (top row of five token-square groups, dark-red Residual/Norm bar, five royal-blue 'Masked Multi-Head Self Attention' 3D boxes, purple 'Word and Position Encoding' bar, five pale-green word boxes SOS/Je/me/sens/malade). A left column contains three Y-tagged token groups, a large royal-blue 'Transformer Encoder' box, the English input words 'I / feel / Sick', and a 'SOS = Start Of Sentence' legend. A yellow '52' badge sits top-right.
